calls.title: Hien Lam and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting centered on enhancing website speed and user experience following challenges with the Bright Scout launch. The team discussed achieving a Lighthouse mobile performance score target of 55 while emphasizing a mobile-first SEO strategy that aligns with Google’s ranking priorities. Additionally, plans for content expansion include integrating AI messaging and revamping the pricing page, along with potential creation of a podcast microsite. Flexible engagement and support models, such as retainer subscriptions and punch cards, were emphasized to adapt to varying client needs. A commitment to high design quality standards was highlighted, ensuring adherence to brand expectations while making performance improvements.
calls.keywords: Website performance, Webflow development, SEO optimization, Content management system, Design standards, Agency partnership
